title: GMT dated pay-month intake and correction contract

ownership.storage: GMT Web-App SharePoint / Shared Documents / Timesheets

observedLive.trigger: Shared mailbox V2 on accounts8765@gmtelectservsltd.onmicrosoft.com / Inbox; this address is absent from the loaded Exchange mailbox list and the trigger has reported ErrorInvalidUser
observedLive.recordFilter: Only non-inline application/json attachments whose name contains GMT Timesheet Record -
observedLive.indexOrdering: Create item precedes attachment validation and Excel Run script; source ID is Outlook message ID
observedLive.heldCorrections: Michelle, Matthew and Simon protected queue entries currently have XLSX and CSV only, so this JSON filter cannot run their workbook update

requiredTrigger.rule: Choose a connector/connection that demonstrably has Full Access to the real Accounts mailbox, or a verified GMT-owned shared mailbox route. Do not point a shared-mailbox trigger at the nonexistent legacy address. Prove an actual new run before replay.

acceptedRecordJson: An array of legacy dated row objects
One schemaVersion 2 replace-pay-month envelope with rows and stable recordId

routing.authority: The Date field of every daily row; weekStart, weekEnd, subject and receive date are not payroll dates
routing.periodPolicy: Use pay-periods.js: four-week cycles anchored 2026-08-24, labelled by the Friday in week four. The displayed 2026-09 payroll Friday is 2026-09-18; the immediately following weekend remains in that cycle until payroll policy says otherwise.
routing.mixedPayMonths: Partition a legacy attachment into one per-pay-month row array. Never rewrite its Date values to fit the named week. Replacement snapshots must belong to exactly one declared pay month.
checksBeforeExcel: Parse controlled record JSON and require one verified employee identity and a stable source record ID
Reject inconsistent employee names/emails, invalid or duplicate Date values, and declared months that disagree with Date
Hold future worked days and off-roster default worked rows for source review; do not infer absence
Ensure the exact company workbook exists and contains only Daily Entries and Weekly Totals

writeOrder: Validate the source attachment and partition by dated pay month
Run the tested pay-month register v3 Office Script against each exact company workbook
Check each script result and read back the dated rows and weekly/month totals
Upsert the protected list/history item using the stable source record ID after the workbook update succeeds
Mark the message processed only after all partitions and index writes succeed

corrections.queueRequirement: Regenerate each held correction with the controlled GMT Timesheet Record JSON attachment before delivery; the existing XLSX/CSV pair alone is insufficient
corrections.idempotency: Reuse the original stable record ID or an explicit correction ID linked to it; do not create another independent active employee month
corrections.audit: Keep editor identity, edit time, affected Date values, and source message/run ID in the protected record; notify the employee and both Accounts recipients

certification.perSource: Source message and attachment hash -> new successful trigger/run -> Run script workbook path and created/updated/unchanged counts -> downloaded SharePoint workbook cell comparison -> portal history projection
certification.perEmployee: One active company workbook, two required tabs, all evidenced dated rows, accurate numeric break and total hours, weekly/month totals, resolved or explicitly provisional source conflicts
certification.holdUntil: Do not release the three protected corrections or send reviewer workbooks before the trigger, route, script and one isolated test replay are proven
